subject: general
question: Which of the following handed over the first production lot of KALPANA3201—a 32-bit microprocessor developed for space applications—to Dr. V. Narayanan, Secretary, DOS / Chairman, Indian Space Research Organisation (ISRO), in March 2025?

options.text: Jitin Prasada, Minister of State, Ministry of Electronics and Information Technology (MeitY)
Narendra Modi, Prime Minister of India
S. Krishnan, Secretary, Ministry of Electronics and Information Technology (MeitY)

solution:
The correct answer is S. Krishnan, Secretary, Ministry of Electronics and Information Technology (MeitY). [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• **KALPANA3201** is a **32-bit microprocessor** developed specifically for **space applications**. It showcases India's growing expertise in indigenous technological advancements.
 
• The **first production lot** of the microprocessor, KALPANA3201, was handed over in **March 2025** to **Dr. V. Narayanan**, who serves as the **Secretary of the Department of Space (DOS)** and the **Chairman of ISRO**.
